---
title: "Raw annual LSWT is the primary warming representation"
aliases:
  - "/explorations/warming-acceleration/decisions/raw-annual-primary-metrics.html"
---

## Context

The project needs one stable basis for long-term warming and changing local
warming speed.

## Choice

Use raw annual-mean reconstructed LSWT for full-period Theil--Sen warming,
endpoint-aligned trailing 10-year Theil--Sen local speed, and the Sen trend of
that speed sequence. Call the last quantity *warming-speed change*, not physical
acceleration.

## Alternatives and evidence

STL trends and adjacent-difference formulations were considered. STL remains
useful for the PCA input, but the raw annual representation best preserves one
consistent primary metric and is directly inspectable in the descriptive draft.

## Consequences and reversibility

All main warming claims use raw annual LSWT. Changing this decision would
require rerunning the metric comparison and revising the analysis contract.
